description: This class provides static methods to generate test data for a book project, including authors, books, publishers, tags, and predefined shelves. It is used to create mock data for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestData
classes.description: Utility class for generating test data related to books, authors, publishers, tags, and shelves for testing purposes.

methods.name: generateRandomNumberInRange
methods.description: Generates a random integer between 300 and 1000.

methods.name: generateAuthors
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined authors.

methods.name: generateBooks
methods.description: Generates a list of books with random attributes based on provided authors, tags, shelves, and publishers.

methods.name: generatePublishers
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined publishers.

methods.name: generateListOfTags
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined tags.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Creates a Book object with randomly assigned properties based on input lists.

methods.name: generateRandomAuthor
methods.description: Selects a random author from the list.

methods.name: generateRandomPublishers
methods.description: Creates a set of publishers, selecting one randomly from the list.

methods.name: generateRandomGenre
methods.description: Selects a random genre from the BookGenre enum.

methods.name: generateRandomRecommender
methods.description: Selects a random recommender name from a predefined list.

methods.name: generateRandomTag
methods.description: Selects a random tag from the list.

methods.name: generateRandomSeriesPosition
methods.description: Generates a random series position between 1 and 10.

methods.name: generateRandomPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Selects a random predefined shelf from the provided list.

methods.name: generateRandomPublicationYear
methods.description: Generates a random publication year between 1920 and 2020.

methods.name: setPredefinedShelfForBooks
methods.description: Assigns predefined shelves to books and updates related status fields based on shelf type.
